id.instruksi: Dengarkan kejadian di taman, lalu sentuh tugas rangka yang paling terlihat di situ.
id.p-kepalabola: Kepala Dani terkena bola, tetapi otaknya tetap aman di dalam tulang tengkorak. Apa tugas rangka di sini?
id.p-jatuh: Sari jatuh telungkup di rumput. Jantung dan paru-parunya aman karena terkurung tulang rusuk. Apa tugasnya?
id.p-mata: Bola mata berada di dalam lubang tulang tengkorak yang kuat, sehingga tidak mudah terbentur. Apa tugas tulang itu?
id.p-angkatbeban: Paman mengangkat karung beras di bahunya. Tulang kakinya menahan semua berat itu. Apa tugasnya?
id.p-ransel: Tulang belakang menahan beban ransel yang berat sehingga badan tetap tegak saat berjalan. Apa tugasnya?
id.p-jerapah: Jerapah di kebun binatang berdiri di atas empat tulang kaki yang panjang dan kuat. Apa tugas tulang kakinya?
id.p-menulis: Saat menggambar di bangku taman, tulang-tulang jari bergerak di sendinya karena ditarik otot. Apa tugasnya?
id.p-lari: Saat berlari mengejar layang-layang, otot menarik tulang paha dan tulang kering di sendi lutut. Apa tugas tulang di sini?
id.p-menoleh: Saat menoleh ke kiri dan kanan sebelum menyeberang, ruas tulang leher berputar di sendinya. Apa tugasnya?
id.p-kucing: Kucing di taman bertubuh langsing dengan ekor panjang karena susunan tulangnya begitu. Apa tugas rangka di sini?
id.p-rontgen: Dari foto rontgen, dokter langsung tahu itu tangan manusia karena rangkanya membentuk telapak dan lima jari. Apa tugasnya?
id.p-wajah: Bentuk wajah tiap orang berbeda, antara lain karena bentuk tulang pipi dan rahangnya. Apa tugas rangka di sini?

en.instruksi: Listen to what happens in the park, then touch the skeleton's job that shows most clearly.
en.p-kepalabola: A ball hits Dani's head, but his brain stays safe inside his skull. What job is the skeleton doing?
en.p-jatuh: Sari falls flat on the grass. Her heart and lungs are safe inside her rib cage. What job is it doing?
en.p-mata: The eyeballs sit inside strong sockets in the skull, so they are not easily bumped. What job are those bones doing?
en.p-angkatbeban: Uncle carries a sack of rice on his shoulder. His leg bones hold up all that weight. What job are they doing?
en.p-ransel: The backbone holds up a heavy backpack so the body stays upright while walking. What job is it doing?
en.p-jerapah: A giraffe at the zoo stands on four long, strong leg bones. What job are its leg bones doing?
en.p-menulis: While drawing on a park bench, the finger bones move at their joints as muscles pull them. What job are they doing?
en.p-lari: While running after a kite, muscles pull the thigh bone and shin bone at the knee joint. What job are the bones doing?
en.p-menoleh: When you look left and right before crossing, the neck bones turn at their joints. What job are they doing?
en.p-kucing: The park cat has a slim body and a long tail because of the way its bones are arranged. What job is the skeleton doing?
en.p-rontgen: From an X-ray, the doctor can tell it is a human hand because the bones make a palm and five fingers. What job is it doing?
en.p-wajah: Everyone's face looks different, partly because of the shape of their cheekbones and jaw. What job is the skeleton doing?
